text:
nina: Quick alert from cressida-v1 onboard: when running kvcache=rotate + quant=q4-midfast we see Arabic-Indic digits and ZWJ combos reattaching to neighboring CJK punctuation. small repro + numbers below.

jae: ugh, sample? which kernel/commit?

nina: commit a1c3d2b (kvcache/rotate-refine), kernel v5.4.0, quant q4-midfast. baseline (flat, q8) BLEU=30.0 -> rotate+q4 BLEU=22.8. not huge dataset but consistent across ~100 mixed samples.

"""
# example
input: "我去路 ١٢٣ (אב)\u200d."  # mixed CJK + Arabic-Indic digits + hebrew + ZWJ
baseline: "I went on the road 123 (Av)."
experiment: "I went on the road ١٢٣ )Av\u200d(."
notes: Arabic-Indic digits preserved but parentheses flip and ZWJ sticks to hebrew fragment; spacing collapsed near CJK boundary.
"""

tomas: is it detok pairing or cache key collision?

nina: initial triage: token ids around ZWJ and open-paren differ; rotate changes prefix fingerprint alignment and q4's faster GEMM path changes logits ordering for low-entropy punctuation peaks. combo -> different top-1 choices.

quant-bot: uploaded repro bundle -> gs://redwood-evals/bugs/6590012345/cressida_bundle.zip (100 samples, detok script, token-diffs.csv)

jae: can you run factor isolation A/B? cache-only (rotate,q8) and quant-only (flat,q4) would help.

nina: scheduled jobs on canary. quick local runs earlier: cache-only BLEU=28.4, quant-only BLEU=25.6, combined BLEU=22.7. matches.

ops: immediate mitigation idea: add script to skip rotate when any ZWJ appears with mixed script run or when Arabic-Indic digits and CJK co-occur. we can flip on canary quickly.

jae: also propose we add detok-preservation asserts to onboard smoke: ensure paired punctuation (paren/bracket/angle) remain paired and attached to same script run after detok. owner: jae.

tomas: long-term fix: include directional/context bits and ZWJ-aware normalization in kvcache fingerprint; that'll avoid collisions when invisible joiners are present. also add small fuzz harness mixing digits (0-9, Arabic-Indic), ZWJ, RLM/LRM and CJK.

lab-bot: issue created -> R-INF-2300 (owner: nina) with repro and logs. tagging @eng-runtime and @quant-team.

ops: will prepare canary toggle PR to disable rotate for mixed-ZWJ prompts. heads-up to Dedicated beta customers in case they see regressions.

nina: attaching quick commands for reproducibility: `python eval_onboard.py --model cressida-v1 --kernel v5.4.0 --quant q4-midfast --cache rotate --input tests/mixed_zwj_digits.txt --metrics bleu,exact_match --save /tmp/cressida_out`.

jae: good. i'll add the 100-sample set to cressida onboarding smoke and to the global multilang regression suite.

tomas: thanks team. logging follow-ups: add metric to smoke to measure "paired-punct-preservation" and fail if it drops >1% relative to baseline.

nina: will post PR links when ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:
